text_block_list.name: Cool Big Sis
text_block_list.text:
Whoo~! It's time for "Young's Room"~♪ Is 
everybody fevering today, too?!

text_block_list.name: Best Disciple
text_block_list.text:
I-In this corner, we'll be tackling the 
worries of today's hip and happening youth 
head-on! And here is our first guest!

text_block_list.name: Passing M
text_block_list.text: Hello. I am M, a passing Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Best Disciple
text_block_list.text:
Umm... McQueen-san? What seems to be the 
problem—

text_block_list.name: Passing M
text_block_list.text:
"It is 'M'. My trouble is, yes... I cannot 
resist the temptation of sweets!"

text_block_list.name: Passing M
text_block_list.text:
As a Meji... as an umamusume of a 
prestigious house, I must maintain top 
condition for the race. However...!

text_block_list.name: Passing M
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, I succumb to sweet temptations, 
and my weight goes up a little... just a 
tiny bit... Gah...!

text_block_list.name: Cool Big Sis
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~! That problem is totally 
solved with nata de coco!

text_block_list.name: Passing M
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Cool Big Sis
text_block_list.text:
Nata de coco is made of 99% water and 1% 
dietary fiber! That's why it's sweet, low 
in calories, and super healthy♪

text_block_list.name: Cool Big Sis
text_block_list.text:
It also has detoxifying and fat-burning 
effects, so I really recommend it for 
dieting~!

text_block_list.name: Passing M
text_block_list.text:
C-Could such a magical food really 
exist...?!

text_block_list.name: Cool Big Sis
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine! What's truly unacceptable is 
for you to bottle it up and end up feeling 
super down..."

text_block_list.name: Passing M
text_block_list.text: S-So cool, big sis...!

text_block_list.name: Best Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"A top-notch answer, just as expected! Now 
then, our next guest is—"

text_block_list.name: Incognito Idol F
text_block_list.text:
It's your incognito idol, F~♪ My favorite 
running style is "Front Runner"!

text_block_list.name: Best Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"So, Fal... Ahem, Ms. F. What exactly is 
troubling you?"

text_block_list.name: Incognito Idol F
text_block_list.text:
"Falco's troubled over the choreography 
for the new song. What we have now is 
good, but something's missing..."

text_block_list.name: Best Disciple
text_block_list.text: (Casually calling herself Falco...)

text_block_list.name: Best Disciple
text_block_list.text: Um, handsome sis! Please!!

text_block_list.name: Cool Big Sis
text_block_list.text:
I felt a spark...! In other words, you 
want to blow a fresh new wind, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Cool Big Sis
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you the cutting-edge dance 
moves! Once you add these in, you'll be 
per-fect♪

text_block_list.name: Incognito Idol F
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! It feels nostalgic yet fresh, such 
a strange feeling~♪

text_block_list.name: Incognito Idol F
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The new song is a cheer song, so... 
maybe dancing with pom-poms like these 
folding fans would be great!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for your hard work on 'Young 
People's Room'~. Maruzen-san was amazing 
again today...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat nata de coco and dance at the 
disco too, and become even more fab!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...How naive, Chiyo-chan. It's so sweet, 
even a panna cotta would dance on 
stage...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The charm of the hip era isn't just nata 
de coco and discos... There's Italian 
dining, shoulder pads, sweaters tied over 
shoulders... so much more!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you all about it from now on♪ 
The dazzling, bubbly world...!
